findings.title: Background reader thread in createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti is not joined before asserting or exiting
findings.body: In `createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti`, a background `Thread` is started at line 139 that loops until `deletedAll.get()` is true, calling `managedRealm.admin().groups().groups(...)` and adding any thrown exceptions to `caughtExceptions`. After the main thread sets `deletedAll.set(true)` at line 155, it immediately asserts `assertThat(caughtExceptions, Matchers.empty())` without calling `join()` on the background thread. If the background thread is in the middle of an HTTP request when `deletedAll` is set, two problems arise: (1) an exception thrown by that in-flight request will be added to `caughtExceptions` after the assertion has already passed, masking a test failure; and (2) the thread continues running into subsequent test methods in `GroupTest`, issuing concurrent requests against the shared `managedRealm`. Store the `Thread` reference and `join()` it before asserting `caughtExceptions`.
